baseline_probability.formula: mu0=(all dry incidences + 0.5)/(n_dry_runs*10*n_species + 1); mu_species=(species dry incidences + kappa*mu0)/(n_dry_runs*10 + kappa); p_cell=(cell dry detections + kappa*mu_species)/(n_dry_runs + kappa)

null_model.candidate_species_pool: For each State x RouteNumber x RunNumber stratum, use the union of species detected in any eligible run in that stratum. Using the full long-term stratum pool is conservative because the null is allowed to generate species seen only in wetter surveys.

simulation.beta: recompute mean pairwise Sørensen dissimilarity among active stops and fit the same wet-minus-dry rainfall-contrast slope

null_model.uniform_activation: For each matched pair, hold the observed dry matrix fixed. Apply one common additive log-odds shift delta to every candidate species x stop cell. Solve delta so that the expected number of simulated wet incidences equals that pair's observed wet incidence count. This conditions the null on response magnitude in expectation and tests allocation/geometry rather than total activation.

frozen_core_claims: Recent-rain conditions are associated with expansion of the behaviourally realized acoustic community across active spatial footprint, local alpha richness and route gamma richness in NAAMP.
Active-unit taxonomic depth has the same recent-rain direction in the aligned NAAMP and FrogID analyses; this is cross-dataset consistency, not independent validation or a pooled effect-size claim.
The North American four-component incidence allocation strongly rejects the original magnitude-matched uniform-activation null under kappa 1, 2 and 5.
The allocation also strongly rejects the persistence-preserving uniform-activation stress test at dry-state anchor weights 0.50, 0.75 and 0.90.
The boundary-biased allocation and all three headline expansion coefficients persist in the large same-observer subset.
Pairwise Sorensen change remains secondary bounded context rather than the structural discovery.
RC11_STORY_FREEZE_V0_1.json.frozen_interpretation: Rainfall-associated expansion enters the behaviourally realized frog community more strongly across spatial and taxonomic boundaries than uniform activation predicts; the pattern survives strong dry-state persistence and restriction to surveys made by the same recorded observer.
frozen_negative_boundaries: No rainfall causality, occupancy, abundance, colonization, extinction or demographic-recruitment claim.
No independent-validation or worldwide-universality claim from FrogID.
No unique biological mechanism identified by uniform-null rejection.
No claim that observers are interchangeable.
No claim that the same-observer restriction removes all detectability bias.
No claim that species-specific activation heterogeneity has been excluded.
The species-specific activation-shift null is explicitly reserved and untested.
Activation geometry remains falsified as a rainfall-specific species trait.
No title-level homogenization claim and no confirmatory Sorensen-equivalence claim.

RC11_STORY_FREEZE_V0_1.json.title: Rainfall-associated expansion of frog active communities is more boundary-biased than uniform activation predicts

authorized_new_endpoint_family: Australian FrogID continuous taxonomic depth within already-active recordings, using the already frozen FrogID sample and timezone-repaired ERA5 dry-spell exposure.
Cross-system directional comparison against the already authorized NAAMP local-alpha result among active stops.
not_authorized: replacement of the RC8 North American matrix-geometry test

promotion_rule.cross_continental_consistency: Authorized only if the Australian primary continuous-depth coefficient is negative with its complete 95% CI below zero, while the already frozen NAAMP active-alpha coefficient remains positive with its complete 95% CI above zero.
promotion_rule.failure: If the Australian primary gate fails, retain FrogID as a historical differently conditioned contrast and do not add cross-continental generality to the RC8 headline.
promotion_rule.strong_cross_continental_consistency: Additionally requires the Australian recorder-clustered and within-ERA5-cell continuous-depth sensitivities to have negative coefficients with complete 95% CIs below zero.

RC8_CROSSCONTINENTAL_DEPTH_UNFREEZE_V0_1.reason: Test whether the most generalizable component of RC8—taxonomic deepening within already-active sampling units—shows the same rainfall-associated direction in independent North American and Australian monitoring systems.
RC8_CROSSCONTINENTAL_DEPTH_UNFREEZE_V0_1.wording_boundary: Even a strong pass authorizes cross-continental consistency across independent North American and Australian monitoring systems, not a world-wide or universal response.

CROSSCONTINENTAL_ACTIVE_DEPTH_SUMMARY_V0.authorized_wording: cross-continental consistency in rainfall-associated taxonomic deepening within already-active acoustic units

historical_two_plus_context.interpretation: The earlier binary >=2-species threshold was null in NAAMP. The new cross-system result concerns continuous active-unit taxonomic depth, and the existing NAAMP decomposition places about 71% of its alpha slope beyond the second species. Australian >=3 and excess-beyond-two endpoints also support deeper multiplicity.

north_america.interpretation: greater wetter-drier rainfall contrast predicts greater taxonomic depth among active stops
north_america.response: mean species richness per active stop; excess richness = alpha_active - 1

NAAMP_METACOMMUNITY_ALPHA_BETA_GAMMA_SUM.interpretation: Rainfall contrast increases local alpha diversity within active stops and route-scale gamma diversity while leaving among-active-stop beta diversity essentially unchanged. The acoustically realized metacommunity expands in parallel across local and route scales without detectable spatial homogenization or differentiation.

NAAMP_PERSISTENCE_PRESERVING_NULL_SUMMAR.ecological_hypothesis_boundary: Preferential recruitment of combinations rare in dry conditions, including temporary or intermittently suitable wet sites, is a plausible discussion-level explanation only; no unique mechanism or causal rainfall effect is identified.
NAAMP_PERSISTENCE_PRESERVING_NULL_SUMMAR.interpretation: The observed four-component allocation remains strongly inconsistent with uniform activation even when the null uses cell-only historical frequencies and strongly anchors each pair to its observed dry species x stop state. The result therefore cannot be attributed simply to hierarchical shrinkage weakening persistent species x stop identity.

title_support.candidate_title: Rainfall-associated expansion of frog active communities is more boundary-biased than uniform activation predicts

NAAMP_SAME_OBSERVER_ROBUSTNESS_SUMMARY_V.interpretation: Observer turnover does not explain the RC10 headline expansion or boundary-biased allocation within the same-observer subset. This is a robustness result, not proof of observer equivalence or a causal rainfall effect.

NAAMP_SORENSEN_EQUIVALENCE_SUMMARY_V0_1..authorized_interpretation: The rainfall-contrast slope of mean pairwise Sørensen dissimilarity is practically equivalent to zero within the fixed +/-0.025 margin in both the primary and exact-consecutive-year samples.

NAAMP_UNIFORM_ACTIVATION_NULL_SUMMARY_V0.authorized_interpretation: The observed incidence allocation is not captured by a common log-odds increase applied uniformly to dry-side acoustic detection propensities. Boundary crossing, especially corner expansion and taxonomic deepening, is overrepresented and within-core rearrangement is underrepresented relative to that null.
NAAMP_UNIFORM_ACTIVATION_NULL_SUMMARY_V0.boundary: Rejecting the null does not identify a unique causal mechanism or validate a species-level response trait.
